_evidence: Source record esi for 0x00540825: 'lodsb; movzx; imul 0x18; add 0x7c2b3c' selects a 0x18-byte name slot from the first byte, then up to 0x17 bytes are copied until a zero byte ('lodsb; or al,al; je'), the slot always ending in a written zero (after the 0x17-byte limit: 'dec ecx; jne' falls through to 'mov al,0; stosb'). The table at 0x7c2b3c holds 22 driver-name slots (0..21) followed by the team names, so the index draws 0..21 mostly, plus 22/0x2f/0xff (still inside writable .data: 0x7c2b3c + 0xff*0x18 + 0x18 < the section end; the original never faults on any byte). The earlier spec drew the index from the character set (slots 65..79 almost always). Name bytes +1..+0x3f draw letters, a space and zero (zero in 1 of 12), so the copy stops at every length and runs into the 0x17-byte limit in about one case in seven ((11/12)^23). Values are synthetic.
